errors.evidence: The description claims the vertical axis is labeled "题目个数" (number of questions), but the figure image shows no label on the vertical axis.

The description incorrectly identifies the tick interval as the unit by stating '单位为 10' (unit is 10). The value 10 represents the major tick interval on the y-axis, not the unit of measurement. The unit is 'number of questions', which is omitted.
